brand.name: EcoCity Hub
brand.tagline: One Platform. Three Problems. One Greener City.
brand.footerQuote: Empowering community vigilance for cleaner, safer streets.
brand.creator: Tanisha Sharma | JECRC University

hero.title: Together, Let's Build a Greener City.
hero.desc: Track your environmental impact, report local civic problems, and take better care of plants with AI-powered tools. Every small action contributes to a cleaner and more sustainable community.

about.title: About EcoCity Hub
about.subtitle: Bridging Civic Vigilance, Eco-Consciousness, and Plant Care with AI
about.desc: EcoCity Hub is an integrated platform combining three critical pillars of modern urban sustainability: measuring personal carbon footprint, empowering citizens to report neighbourhood civic infrastructure problems, and providing instant AI diagnostics for home and urban plants.
about.pillar1Desc: Accurate, deterministic emissions calculations coupled with Gemini AI to generate realistic, personalized decarbonization advice.
about.pillar2Desc: Upload street photographs to let vision AI automatically categorize civic problems, estimate urgency, and draft municipal complaints.
about.pillar3Desc: Diagnose leaf diseases, identify plant species, and receive safe organic remedies and prevention advice.

features.sectionSubtitle: Three intelligent modules designed to transform how citizens interact with their environment.
features.feat1Subtitle: Understand how your daily lifestyle affects the environment.
features.feat1P1: Transportation tracking across cars, bikes, public transit, and walking.
features.feat1P2: Electricity consumption analytics based on monthly kWh.
features.feat2Subtitle: Help make your neighbourhood cleaner and safer.
features.feat2P1: Upload photos or videos of potholes, garbage, broken lights, and water leaks.
features.feat2P2: Gemini Vision AI categorizes issues and detects urgency.
features.feat2P3: Drafts ready-to-submit municipal complaints in seconds.
features.feat2P5: Track real statuses from Draft to Resolved.
features.feat3Subtitle: Give your plants better care using AI.
features.feat3P1: Snap or upload leaf photos/videos for immediate AI diagnostics.
features.feat3P3: Root cause detection and pathogen identification.
features.feat3P5: Full plant care history and health tracking.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Four simple steps to empower yourself and your community.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Sign up in seconds, set your Indian state and city, and unlock your personal dashboard.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Compute your emissions, snap or record a civic hazard, or inspect a drooping houseplant.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Implement Gemini's recommendations, submit civic complaints, or complete weekly challenges.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Level up from Green Beginner to Planet Protector and unlock community recognition.

whyChoose.title: Why Choose EcoCity Hub?
whyChoose.subtitle: Combining artificial intelligence, civic empowerment, and real gamification.
whyChoose.point1Desc: Vision-capable Gemini models provide instant analysis for photos/videos and complex lifestyle data.
whyChoose.point2Desc: Real mathematical emission factors demystify your personal environmental footprint.
whyChoose.point3Desc: Turn street-level frustration into actionable, professionally formatted civic reports.
whyChoose.point4Desc: Keep urban greenery thriving with timely disease detection and safe home care tips.
whyChoose.point5Desc: Collaborate with neighbours for cleaner streets and healthier public spaces.
whyChoose.point6Desc: Transparent Green Score points computed directly from verified actions, not arbitrary numbers.

cta.title: Small Actions. Meaningful Change.
cta.desc: Your city becomes better when everyone contributes. Start your journey towards a greener tomorrow with EcoCity Hub.
